title: Spinach and Vegetable Soup with Radishes
description: This spinach and vegetable soup with radishes recipe uses a unique combo of veggies like yucca instead of potatoes. Finish it with a squeeze of lemon.
ingredients: 2 yuca roots, peeled and cut into small pieces
1 small bunch cilantro leaves, stems removed, or to taste

steps.text: Place a steamer insert into a saucepan. Fill with water just below the bottom of the steamer. Bring water to a boil. Add spinach, cover, and steam until tender, 2 to 6 minutes. Keep warm.

Place yucca in a large pot with enough water to cover; bring to a boil, cover, and cook until tender, about 15 minutes. Add carrots, cabbage, zucchini, and cilantro; add more water to cover, if needed. Bring to a boil; add bouillon cubes and turmeric. Reduce heat; simmer until vegetables are tender, 10 to 15 minutes.
Divide soup among serving bowls; add spinach. Top with radishes; serve with lemon slices.
